name: AccessLens AI
tagline: Transform dense medical, legal, financial & technical text into plain English, checklists, dyslexia studios, WCAG HTML repairs, narration & concept maps.
changelog: Initial Founding Builder Program release: 3-tier Plain-Language Translator (Flesch-Kincaid & Gunning Fog), Persistent Action & Red-Flag Risk Extractor (.ics/Markdown + Anna APS), WCAG 2.2 AAA Dyslexia/Bionic/Line-Ruler Studio, Automated WCAG 2.2 HTML Repair Engine, Karaoke Narration (Web Speech + Anna TTS), and Interactive Concept Map.
description:
AccessLens AI turns dense medical discharge notes, legal contracts, financial disclosures, and technical advisories into accessible, actionable clarity inside Anna OS.

### Six Core Capabilities
1. **Plain-Language Summary & Reading-Level Translator:** Instant Flesch-Kincaid Grade & Gunning Fog scoring (before vs. after), inline clickable jargon glossary, and 3 reading modes (*5th-Grade Everyday Plain English*, *Patient / Consumer Clear Brief*, and *Executive High-Signal Digest*) with optional 1-click Anna Host LLM (`llm.complete`) refinement.
2. **Prioritized Action Checklist & Red-Flag Extractor:** Extracts concrete *Who / What / By When* action items and red-flag traps (auto-renewal clauses, drug contraindications, penalty APRs, zero-day CVEs) synced to Anna Persistent Storage (`anna.storage`) with `.ics` calendar and Markdown exports.
3. **Dyslexia-Friendly, ADHD Bionic & Low-Vision Studio:** WCAG 2.2 AAA reading workspace with adjustable Bionic fixation bolding, syllable decoding dots, Warm Cream / Soft Sepia / 21:1 High-Contrast themes, spacing sliders, and an animated Line Focus Ruler.
4. **Automated WCAG 2.2 HTML Accessibility Auditor & Auto-Repair:** Detects missing `alt` attributes, unlabeled form controls, broken heading cascades, non-semantic `div onclick` traps, vague links, tables, landmarks, and low-contrast inline CSS — outputting repaired semantic HTML + ARIA and unified diffs.
5. **Synchronized Karaoke Narration Player:** Sentence-by-sentence and word-tracked audio narration (`0.75x–1.75x` speed) supporting both Browser Web Speech and Anna OS Neural TTS (`audio.speak`).
6. **Interactive Visual Concept Map:** Keyboard-navigable node-edge graph (`<= 24` crisp SVG nodes with ARIA descriptions) mapping how parties, obligations, deadlines, and risks connect.
